lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 6 to 7 distinct vertical white lines are visible; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-torso with a slightly wider gap between the first and second anterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A minor Y-shaped bifurcation is observed on the second major vertical line from the anterior, located approximately 30 percent down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The fourth and sixth lines from the anterior exhibit mid-section discontinuities; most lines terminate before reaching the long hair of the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, positioned above the transition to the orange lower limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral trajectory, extending posteriorly and laterally from the skull before curving medially and dorsally toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.75 times the width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10 to 15 percent of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dense dark hair fringe along the ventral and gular regions; two distinct white spots are visible on the lateral facial plane below the eye.
